description: This header file declares interfaces and components related to touchpad configurations in the Cuttlefish Android emulator. It defines the TouchpadsConfigs interface, the TouchpadsConfigsFlag class, and functions to create dependency injection components for managing touchpad configuration data.

classes.name: TouchpadsConfigs
classes.description: Abstract interface for sharing and managing touchpad configuration data within the system.

classes.name: TouchpadsConfigsFlag
classes.description: Class intended to handle the command line flag for touchpad configurations; inherits from FlagFeature.

methods.name: Name()
methods.description: Returns the name of the touchpad configuration component.

methods.name: GetConfigs()
methods.description: Retrieves the list of touchpad configurations.

methods.name: SetConfigs()
methods.description: Sets the list of touchpad configurations.
